items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...John O'Connell... Those were the list of names in the book. But you and Barney, among other musicians...

ctx.x: Lena Horne, Hazel Scott, Lee Young, Jimmy Dorsey, John O'Connell, Bob Eberle and Barney Bigard. Those were the list of names in the book. But you and Barney, among other musicians...
Well, Lee and I were featured with Hazel Scott in that particular picture...
